name: A dot matrix fills, then marks a fraction
looks: A dense grid of small hollow dots fills in solid, row by row, under a caption naming the total it represents; a beat later, a scattered subset of the same dots stay hollow while the rest go solid, and a new caption names the fraction that subset represents.
build: Dots fill solid on a loose row-by-row stagger (20-30ms per row) rather than all at once. For the fraction beat, the hollow subset is chosen by seeded random indices, not a tidy block, so the proportion reads as organic sampling rather than a clean diagram.
sound: A fast, soft patter as the grid fills, a single lower tone marking the fraction callout.
prompt: Fill a dense grid of small hollow dots solid row by row under a caption naming the total they represent, then mark a scattered, randomly distributed subset of them as still hollow a beat later with a new caption naming the fraction they stand for.
